title: A subroutine that keeps the registers
task: Write sum3: AX <- a + b + c, the words at a, b and c (the sum modulo 10000H). It needs a pointer and a scratch register: use SI and DI, but leave every register except AX as the caller had it (save with PUSH, restore with POP in the reverse order), and return with RET. The main program is given; keep it and the DW lines.
starter:
; keep-registers -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, 8086)
; Write sum3: AX <- a + b + c; every other register as it was.
; Hint: PUSH SI and PUSH DI first, POP DI and POP SI before RET.
        MOV  BX, 1111H          ; values the subroutine must keep
        MOV  CX, 2222H
        MOV  DX, 3333H
        MOV  SI, 4444H
        MOV  DI, 5555H
        MOV  BP, 6666H
        CALL sum3
        MOV  total, AX
        HLT

sum3:   RET                     ; replace with your code

a       DW   0                  ; the tests write a, b and c
b       DW   0
c       DW   0
total   DW   0
